_comment: Hand-minimized from the counterexample found by TestPropertyUncoupledStability/preferred_probe on 2026-07-04. Scenario class: a pod whose ONLY constraint is a ScheduleAnyway zonal topology spread whose selector matches RUNNING pods. Originally this scenario FAILED ~2/3 of runs: the classifier marked the pod Uncoupled while the reused scheduler honored the spread against the domain counts (occupancy A allowed any zone, occupancy B only {zone-2, zone-3}, so the fingerprints diverged). The interim fix classified such pods Coupled; the 2026-07-04 ruling reversed that because a stale preference never invalidates a claim. The fixture now DEMONSTRATES the fix: the builder strips the ScheduleAnyway term before solving (stripPreferredPodTopology), the pod classifies Uncoupled/preferred-only, and the claim fingerprints are byte-identical across both occupancies - it replays green and guards the strip against regression.
